Do not copy the run pose or foot-direction defects from them.
IDENTITY LOCK: anatomical RIGHT hand holds the gold curved short handle carrying the large lotus lantern; anatomical LEFT hand holds the small round jade flask with gold neck and lotus motif. Never swap hands. E facing is screen-right: the character's right arm/leg is near the viewer; left arm/leg is on the far side. Her anatomical-left large hair lotus is far-hidden in E view, not newly placed beside the visible right ear. Preserve long flowing waves, no braid. Lantern is a hanging lotus bowl, not a staff; flask is not a gourd.
Camera and framing: same gently elevated orthographic E side view as images 4–5; face and gaze point right, no rotation toward camera. Native canvas 1254 by 1254, whole character and both props safely within frame. Retain large original character scale: bun top near y80, face around x930 y440; virtual fixed root (800,1164). Transparent RGBA background. Ground is imaginary near y1164; no floor line or shadow. No postprocessing, upscaling, mirroring, cutout assembly or interpolation.
Foot geometry: stable weight bearing, two knees and ankles naturally connected under pelvis. The two pink shoes both point along the E movement axis, rightward in this camera, with readable side silhouettes and longitudinal soles. NO outward-splayed toes, no broad front-facing shoe, no twisting ankle, no ballet turnout. A modest fore/aft stagger supports balance; perspective overlap is natural and is not a wide split. Costume must not hide every contact point.
Primary request: E ATTACK frame 01 of a future 12-frame 360ms basic attack. Draw the anticipation/ready-to-strike beginning, no impact yet. Both feet planted in a compact fore/aft combat stance, knees lightly flexed. Torso winds back only slightly while head still aims right. The near anatomical-right shoulder and bent elbow draw the lotus-lantern handle back beside the right waist/ribs, visibly preparing a forward shoulder/elbow-driven lamp swing. Keep the large lantern bowl hanging safely beside and behind the hip, clear of knees. Far left arm protects the jade bottle near chest/torso. Avoid a straight fully extended running backswing; show deliberate controlled wind-up. Weight gathers over rear support without moving the whole sprite.
Finish/avoid: full polished production illustration, exactly one character, two arms/two legs, readable hands gripping their own objects, no text, watermark, guides, scenery, large baked VFX or extra props. Native transparent background and original global character scale are essential.
